deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a draft of an administrative vote (Votum) by Riemann as a member of the Königliche Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen ('die hiesige Societät'). It responds to a proposal by Wilhelm Weber to admit Richard Dedekind (then Professor at the ETH Zürich) and Dr. Ernst Schering (Göttingen, 'hieselbst') into the Society 'in der beantragten Weise' (in the manner proposed).

Reading of the text: 'Dem Vorschlage des Hrn. Prof. Weber, die Hrn. Professor Richard Dedekind in Zürich und Dr. Ernst Schering hieselbst in der beantragten Weise in die hiesige Societät aufzunehmen, stimme ich mit Freuden bei. Ich halte ihre Aufnahme durch die von Hrn. Prof. Weber hervorgehobenen besonderen Verdienste um die hiesige Societät für hinreichend motivirt, [um nicht?] über ihre sonstigen wissenschaftlichen Leistungen zu referiren.'

Meaning: Riemann gladly agrees. He considers the special services to the Society that Weber highlighted sufficient justification, so that he need not report on their other scientific achievements. Several false starts are struck out: a heading, the phrase 'Ich halte darin', and a phrase after 'motivirt'.

Dating (my inference): Dedekind was in Zürich from 1858 to 1862, and Riemann became an ordinary member of the Society in 1859, which places the draft around 1859–1862. Dedekind is generally reported to have become a corresponding member of the Göttingen Society around 1862. The 'special services to the Society' plausibly refer to editorial work connected with the Society, such as Gauss's Nachlass and Werke, which Schering edited on the Society's behalf (my inference, not stated on the page).

The page is unrelated to the surrounding mathematics. The next page computes the complete elliptic integral K at k^2 = 1/2 (the lemniscatic case) in terms of Π(1/4) = Γ(5/4). The sheet was evidently reused as scrap paper.
errors: No mathematical content. The final sentence as left in the draft is grammatically incomplete. After the deletion following 'motivirt', a connective such as 'um nicht' or 'ohne' seems to be missing before 'über ihre sonstigen wissenschaftlichen Leistungen zu referiren'. This is a drafting slip, not an error of substance.

results.what: Riemann's draft vote supporting W. Weber's proposal to elect R. Dedekind (Zürich) and E. Schering (Göttingen) to the Göttingen Society of Sciences
results.usually_credited_to: n/a (Göttingen Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften records; proposal by Wilhelm Weber)

deep.surprise_reason: Purely administrative text with no mathematics. Riemann's close ties to Weber, Dedekind and Schering are well known, and his support of their election is unsurprising. The draft is of minor biographical and archival interest only.
transcription_corrections: The machine transcription is essentially correct for the main text.
The struck first line likely reads '[Zu?] Vorschlage' or similar. The second line 'Die [...]' may be 'Zu [...]'; both are struck headings and uncertain.

After 'motivirt' the struck passage seems to have a small interlinear word beneath it (possibly 'um'). The surviving sentence needs a connective such as 'um nicht' before 'über ihre sonstigen wissenschaftlichen Leistungen zu referiren'.
'{+Professor+}' is correctly an interlinear insertion above 'Richard Dedekind'.
'Hrn.' before 'Richard Dedekind' could be read as 'Herren' (plural), since two persons are named.
